info.title: Script Assistant API
info.description: Generates customer segments and ready-to-film UGC scripts using Gemini on Vertex AI.

get.description: Health check endpoint for Cloud Run and monitoring probes.

post.summary: Generate customer segments and 3 UGC scripts from product details and image
post.description:
Pipeline:
1. Authenticate request using X-API-Key header.
2. Validate input constraints (market length, image mime type, file size).
3. Stage 1: Send product image + details to Gemini to extract verifiable facts & 3 segments.
4. Stage 2: In parallel, generate 3 UGC scripts customized for each segment with assigned hook styles.
5. Return unified facts, segments, and scripts.

language.title: Language
language.description: Desired script language: 'en' for English or 'bn' for Bangla

image.title: Image
image.description: Product image file (JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 5 MB)

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: 5 to 8 verifiable product facts extracted from image and description

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: The 3 customer segments identified for the product

scripts.title: Scripts
scripts.description: The 3 customized scripts, each targeting one of the customer segments

GenerateResponse.title: GenerateResponse
GenerateResponse.description: The top-level response payload returned by POST /generate.

id.title: Id
id.description: 1-based sequential line index used for referencing in rationale reasons

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Role of this line in the video structure: 'hook' (0-3s), 'concept' (body), or 'cta' (action)

text.title: Text
text.description: Spoken dialogue or voiceover text meant to be delivered naturally on camera

Line.title: Line
Line.description: A single spoken line or beat within a UGC video script.

title.title: Title
title.description: Short name of the performance marketing technique (e.g., 'Curiosity Gap Hook', 'Direct Objection Handling')

why.title: Why
why.description: Explanation of why this technique specifically resonates with this target segment

line_ids.title: Line Ids
line_ids.description: List of 1-based line IDs from the script that demonstrate this technique

Reason.title: Reason
Reason.description: Performance rationale explaining why a specific technique was incorporated into the script.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: Name of the customer segment this script is customized for

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: Ordered sequence of script lines structured as hook, concept, and cta

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Exactly 3 reasons explaining why the script is constructed this way

Script.title: Script
Script.description: Complete ready-to-film short-form video ad script for a specific customer segment.

name.title: Name
name.description: Clear, descriptive title for this customer segment (e.g., 'Exhausted Working Parents')

who.title: Who
who.description: Demographics, daily context, and life situation of this audience persona

pain_point.title: Pain Point
pain_point.description: Core frustration, anxiety, or unmet desire expressed in their own natural words

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Short-form platforms where this segment is most active (e.g., ['TikTok', 'Instagram Reels', 'YouTube Shorts'])

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: Represents a specific target audience / customer segment.
